packages.title: K02 rev: sleeping waits without the global mutex; RWVC_DMA_INFO
depends_on: board: '[hw] lead review K02' (the exact findings)
coordinate every change with opus-kern, who audits the same file: post before editing and merge their corrections
deliverable: K02-L1: in the kernel build, n2vc_wait_irq_locked and the RWVC_OP_POLL loop sleep with msleep(&n2vc, &n2vc_mtx, PZERO, "n2vc-wait", &ts) (ts = 500 us) instead of delay(); time accounted with mach_absolute_time; after every wake re-validate f->used and n2vc.on[blk] before touching hardware (EACCES/ENXIO otherwise); delay() only for waits <= 100 us. The host shim keeps deterministic fake time and gains a hook that runs a callback 'during the sleep' so tests can power off/close concurrently.
K02-L2: RWVC_DMA_INFO exactly as in the header (EINVAL handle 0, ENOENT unknown, EPERM not usable by the caller under the stated rule); remove any local RWVC_DMA_SHARED define.
K02-L3: RWVC_DMA_RW copies in chunks of at most 1 MiB, re-validating the handle after each chunk if the lock was dropped (or keep the lock and just chunk).
STATUS.md updated; DONE rev posted with the test line.

packages.title: Hardware op log: record every n2vc_hw call on the phone, replay it as a fake-hardware script on the PC
depends_on: gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/** (T02's fake hardware: its recorder line format and its script rule format; read only)
facts/VENC_PROTOCOL.md when opus-venc has it (read only)
deliverable: hwlog/n2vc_hw_log.c + .h: int n2vc_hw_wrap_log(struct n2vc_hw *out, const struct n2vc_hw *inner, const char *path): a decorator that forwards every call and appends one line per op in exactly T02's recorder format plus a microsecond timestamp and the result (power, each reg op of a batch with the value read, wait_irq with status/timeout, irq_clear, dma alloc/free with pa, dma_rw with offset/bytes and a 32-bit checksum of the data - never the data). Buffered writes, fsync on close, thread-safe, at most N2HW_HWLOG_MAX_MB (default 16) then it stops logging and says so in the last line. Enabled in vcodecd by the environment variable N2HW_HWLOG=path (post the 3-line hook to hw-ip; do not edit the daemon).

hwlog/log2script.py: converts a recorded phone log into (a) a T02 fake-hardware script that reproduces the hardware's answers in order (reads return the logged values, interrupts fire after the logged delay), (b) a per-register summary (offset, first/last value written, values read, count) for facts/VENC_PROTOCOL.md.
hwlog/diff_logs.py: aligns two logs (PC fake run vs phone run) and prints the first divergence in the sequence of writes, ignoring addresses that differ only by the DMA pool base.
hwlog/README.md: what the main session runs on the phone and which file to copy back.
packages.host_test_oracle: Wrap T02's fake hardware, run a literal op sequence, compare the log text with a literal expected file; log2script output fed back into the fake reproduces the same reads (round trip); diff_logs on two logs with one changed write reports exactly that line. ASan/UBSan and TSan.
acceptance_check: bash gpu/hwcodec/hwlog/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST X01 PASS n/n
